title: Algorithmic Fairness and Structural Injustice: Insights from Feminist Political Philosophy
benchmark_measurement: The paper does not conduct a benchmark and does not measure anything related to faith/religion. It is a theoretical paper discussing algorithmic fairness and structural injustice.
findings: The paper makes no findings related to religion. The term 'faith-based organizations' is mentioned once as an example of a collective group that can be organized to address structural injustice, alongside labor unions and stockholder groups.
